key.name: auto-hide
key.summary: When the island slides out of the way
key.description: never: always shown. fullscreen: hidden while a window is fullscreen. smart: also hidden while a window reaches up under it.

key.name: blur
key.description: Blur what is behind the island. Turn off for a plain dark island on slower graphics.

key.name: monitor
key.description: Index of the monitor the island sits on, or -1 for the primary monitor.

key.name: notifications
key.description: Replace GNOME's notification banners with the island.

key.name: charge-limit
key.summary: Battery charge limit the Charge Limit toggle turns on

key.name: palette-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the command palette

key.name: notes-folder
key.summary: Folder of Markdown notes the palette searches (empty: no notes search)

key.name: inbox-folder
key.summary: Where quick notes are saved: a path, or a folder inside the notes folder (empty: the notes folder)

key.name: show-privacy-bubble
key.summary: Show the microphone and camera bubble while they are in use

key.name: show-chat-bubble
key.summary: Show the chat bubble next to the bell
